74:     public static boolean permitted(double start,double end,String policy) {
75:         if(!Set.of(OVERNIGHT_POLICY,LEGACY_RESIDENCE_POLICY).contains(policy))return false;
76:         double nightEnd=OVERNIGHT_POLICY.equals(policy)?104400:86400;
77:         return Double.isFinite(start) && Double.isFinite(end) && start<=end &&
78:             (start>=0 && end<18000 || start>=32400 && end<57600 || start>=75600 && end<nightEnd);
79:     }

src/main/java/gt/edu/uvg/sim/zona1/SimZ1Freight.java:201
201:             cleanupTime=e.getTime();
202:             return;
203:         }
204:         var a=e.getAttributes();
205:         String id=a.getOrDefault("person",a.get("vehicle"));
206:         if (!fleet.contains(id)) return;
207:         String kind=e.getEventType();
208:         boolean abort=kind.equals("stuckAndAbort")||kind.equals("vehicle aborts");
209:         if(!MOVEMENT.contains(kind) && !Set.of("departure","arrival","simz1NativeDecision").contains(kind) && !abort)return;
210:         double time=e.getTime();
211:         if(!Double.isFinite(time)||time<lastTimes.getOrDefault(id,Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY))
212:             throw new IllegalStateException("Freight invalid/non-monotone event time: "+id);
213:         lastTimes.put(id,time);
214:         Person person=scenario.getPopulation().getPersons().get(Id.createPersonId(id));
215:         var path=Arrays.asList(person.getAttributes().getAttribute("simz1FreightRoute").toString().split(" "));
216:         if(kind.equals("departure")) {
217:             double planned=Double.parseDouble(person.getAttributes().getAttribute("simz1FreightDeparture").toString());
218:             if(started.contains(id)||terminals.containsKey(id)||Math.abs(time-planned)>1.01||!path.get(0).equals(a.get("link")))
219:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Freight duplicate/late/incorrect departure: "+id);
220:             started.add(id); active.put(id,time); departures.put(id,time);
221:         }
222:         if((MOVEMENT.contains(kind)||kind.equals("departure")||kind.equals("arrival")) && !path.contains(a.get("link")))
223:             throw new IllegalStateException("Freight outside configured route: "+id);
224:         if((MOVEMENT.contains(kind)||kind.equals("arrival")) && !active.containsKey(id))
225:             throw new IllegalStateException("Freight movement/arrival without active departure: "+id);
226:         if(MOVEMENT.contains(kind)&&!kind.equals("vehicle enters traffic")&&!traffic.containsKey(id))
227:             throw new IllegalStateException("Freight movement without traffic entry: "+id);
228:         if(kind.equals("vehicle enters traffic")) {
229:             if(seen.contains(id)||!id.equals(a.get("vehicle"))||!path.get(0).equals(a.get("link")))
230:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Freight vehicle/driver identity mismatch: "+id);
231:             seen.add(id); positions.put(id,0); traffic.put(id,time); entries.put(id,time);
232:         }
233:         residence(id,time,kind);
234:         if(kind.equals("entered link")) {
235:             int index=positions.getOrDefault(id,-1)+1;
236:             if(index>=path.size()||!path.get(index).equals(a.get("link")))
237:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Freight route sequence mismatch: "+id);
238:             positions.put(id,index);
239:         }
240:         if(kind.equals("vehicle leaves traffic")) { traffic.remove(id); exits.put(id,time); }
241:         if(kind.equals("arrival")) {
242:             if(positions.getOrDefault(id,-1)!=path.size()-1||!path.get(path.size()-1).equals(a.get("link")))
243:                 throw new IllegalStateException("Freight incomplete route/arrival: "+id);
244:             active.remove(id); terminals.put(id,new Terminal("completed",time,new HashSet<>(Set.of(kind))));
245:         }
246:         if(abort) {
247:             var terminal=terminals.get(id);
248:             if(terminal!=null) {
249:                 if(!Set.of("aborted","aborted_before_departure").contains(terminal.status)||terminal.time!=time||!terminal.sources.add(kind))
250:                     throw new IllegalStateException("Freight conflicting/duplicate terminal event: "+id);
251:             } else {
252:                 boolean neverStarted=!started.contains(id)&&!active.containsKey(id);
253:                 if(!active.containsKey(id)&&!(neverStarted&&Double.isFinite(cleanupTime)&&time>=cleanupTime))
254:                     throw new IllegalStateException("Freight abort without departure: "+id);
255:                 active.remove(id);
256:                 terminals.put(id,new Terminal(neverStarted?"aborted_before_departure":"aborted",time,new HashSet<>(Set.of(kind))));
257:             }
258:         }
259:         if(kind.equals("arrival")||abort) { traffic.remove(id); positions.remove(id); }
260:     }

48:     static <T> Set<T> selectCohort(List<T> sortedIds,double share,long seed) {
49:         var shuffled=new ArrayList<>(sortedIds); Collections.shuffle(shuffled,new Random(seed));
50:         return new HashSet<>(shuffled.subList(0,(int)Math.floor(shuffled.size()*share)));
51:     }

src/main/java/gt/edu/uvg/sim/zona1/CongestionAwareRerouting.java:76
76:     @Override public void handleEvent(VehicleEntersTrafficEvent e) {
77:         if (isRegisteredTransitVehicle(e.getVehicleId())) return;
78:         entries.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString()); pendingTurns.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
79:         traversed.put(e.getVehicleId().toString(),List.of(e.getLinkId()));
80:     }
81:     @Override public void handleEvent(VehicleLeavesTrafficEvent e) {
82:         if (isRegisteredTransitVehicle(e.getVehicleId())) return;
83:         entries.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString()); pendingTurns.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
84:         traversed.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
85:     }
86:     @Override public void handleEvent(LinkEnterEvent e) {
87:         // Stop dwell belongs to the fixed service, not an estimate of car running time.
88:         if (isRegisteredTransitVehicle(e.getVehicleId())) return;
89:         Exit previous=pendingTurns.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
90:         if (previous!=null && previous.entry().time()<=previous.time() && previous.time()<=e.getTime()) {
91:             var from=scenario.getNetwork().getLinks().get(previous.entry().link());
92:             var to=scenario.getNetwork().getLinks().get(e.getLinkId());
93:             if (from!=null && to!=null && from.getToNode()==to.getFromNode())
94:                 turnObservations.put(new Turn(from.getId(),to.getId()),
95:                     new Observation(e.getTime()-previous.entry().time(),e.getTime()));
96:         }
97:         entries.put(e.getVehicleId().toString(),new Entry(e.getLinkId(),e.getTime()));
98:         traversed.computeIfPresent(e.getVehicleId().toString(),(id,old)->{
99:             var path=new ArrayList<>(old); path.add(e.getLinkId()); return List.copyOf(path);
100:         });
101:     }
102:     @Override public void handleEvent(LinkLeaveEvent e) {
103:         if (isRegisteredTransitVehicle(e.getVehicleId())) return;
104:         Entry entry=entries.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
105:         pendingTurns.remove(e.getVehicleId().toString());
106:         if (entry!=null && entry.link().equals(e.getLinkId()) && e.getTime()>=entry.time()) {
107:             observations.put(entry.link(),new Observation(e.getTime()-entry.time(),e.getTime()));
108:             pendingTurns.put(e.getVehicleId().toString(),new Exit(entry,e.getTime()));
109:         }
110:     }
111:     private static boolean fresh(Observation observation,double now) {
112:         return observation!=null && now>=observation.time() && now-observation.time()<=300;
113:     }
114:     double observedLinkSeconds(Id<Link> link,double now) {
115:         var observation=observations.get(link);
116:         return fresh(observation,now)?observation.duration():Double.NaN;
117:     }
118:     double observedTurnSeconds(Id<Link> from,Id<Link> to,double now) {
119:         var observation=turnObservations.get(new Turn(from,to));
120:         return fresh(observation,now)?observation.duration():Double.NaN;
121:     }
122:     static boolean shouldInstall(boolean enabled,double oldCost,double candidateCost) {
123:         if (!Double.isFinite(oldCost) || oldCost<0 || !Double.isFinite(candidateCost) || candidateCost<0)
124:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid estimated rerouting costs");
125:         return enabled && candidateCost+1e-9<oldCost;
126:     }
127:     static boolean needsReroute(boolean enabled,double nominal,double estimate,double baseCapacity,double currentCapacity) {
128:         if (!Double.isFinite(nominal) || nominal<=0 || !Double.isFinite(estimate) || estimate<0 ||
129:             !Double.isFinite(baseCapacity) || baseCapacity<=0 || !Double.isFinite(currentCapacity) || currentCapacity<0)
130:             throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid congestion or capacity evidence");
131:         return enabled && ((estimate>=3*nominal && estimate-nominal>=60) || currentCapacity<=.5*baseCapacity);
132:     }
133:     @Override public void notifyMobsimInitialized(MobsimInitializedEvent event) {

139:         ids.removeIf(id->SimZ1Freight.applies(scenario.getPopulation().getPersons().get(id)));
140:         selected=selectCohort(ids,config.getAgentShare(),scenario.getConfig().global().getRandomSeed()+iteration);
141:         last.clear(); times.clear(); turnTimes.clear(); entries.clear(); pendingTurns.clear(); observations.clear(); turnObservations.clear();
142:         traversed.clear(); next=Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY; cursor="";
143:         safety=new SimZ1RouteSafety(scenario);
144:         router=new SimZ1TurnRouter(scenario.getNetwork(),safety,
145:             (link,time,person,vehicle)->times.getOrDefault(link.getId(),Double.NaN),
146:             (from,to,time,person,vehicle)->turnTimes.getOrDefault(new Turn(from.getId(),to.getId()),
147:                 times.getOrDefault(from.getId(),Double.NaN)),routingPolicy);
148:         // Already-routed inputs must be valid even when rerouting is switched off.
149:         for (var person:scenario.getPopulation().getPersons().values()) {

153:                     if (reason!=null) {
154:                         String evidence="person="+person.getId()+" iteration="+iteration+" oldRoute="+full+" reason="+reason;
155:                         LOG.error("Invalid initial route: {}",evidence);

src/main/java/gt/edu/uvg/sim/zona1/CongestionAwareRerouting.java:232
232:     private void attempt(MobsimAgent agent,double now,Step step) {
233:         var leg=WithinDayAgentUtils.getModifiableCurrentLeg(agent);
234:         var route=(NetworkRoute)leg.getRoute(); var old=SimZ1RouteSafety.full(route);
235:         int index=WithinDayAgentUtils.getCurrentRouteLinkIdIndex(agent);
236:         String invalid=safety.validateReplacement(old,old,index,agent.getCurrentLinkId(),route.getEndLinkId(),null);
237:         if (invalid!=null) fatal(now,agent,index,old,null,invalid);
238:         Position position=locate((MobsimDriverAgent)agent);
239:         if (position==null) {
240:             step.rejected++; evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,null,null,"physical_vehicle_or_lane_not_ready"); return;
241:         }
242:         if (!position.link().equals(agent.getCurrentLinkId())) fatal(now,agent,index,old,position,"agent_vehicle_link_mismatch");
243:         var history=traversed.get(position.vehicle().getId().toString());
244:         if (history==null) {
245:             step.rejected++; evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,null,position,"physical_history_not_ready"); return;
246:         }
247:         if (!history.equals(old.subList(0,index+1))) fatal(now,agent,index,old,position,"traversed_event_prefix_mismatch actual="+history);
248:         invalid=safety.validateReplacement(old,old,index,position.link(),route.getEndLinkId(),position.lane());
249:         if (invalid!=null) fatal(now,agent,index,old,position,invalid);
250:         step.calculations++;
251:         var person=scenario.getPopulation().getPersons().get(agent.getId());
252:         var vehicle=scenario.getVehicles().getVehicles().get(position.vehicle().getId());
253:         Entry entry=entries.get(position.vehicle().getId().toString());
254:         double enteredAt=entry!=null && entry.link().equals(position.link())?entry.time():Double.NaN;
255:         List<Id<Link>> suffix;
256:         try { suffix=router.path(position.link(),route.getEndLinkId(),now,person,vehicle,position.lane(),enteredAt,
257:                                  List.copyOf(history)); }
258:         catch (RuntimeException error) {
259:             evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,null,position,"calculation_exception: "+error);
260:             throw error; // keep exception and traceback, rather than disguising an implementation error as no-path
261:         }
262:         last.put(agent.getId(),now);
263:         var candidate=suffix==null?null:SimZ1RouteSafety.splice(old,index,suffix);
264:         invalid=candidate==null?"no_allowed_path":safety.validateReplacement(old,candidate,index,position.link(),route.getEndLinkId(),position.lane());
265:         if (invalid!=null) {
266:             step.rejected++; evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,candidate,position,invalid); return;
267:         }
268:         invalid=org.matsim.core.mobsim.qsim.qnetsimengine.SimZ1CorridorOccupancy.replacementIssue(
269:             scenario.getConfig().qsim(),position.vehicle().getId(),candidate,index,qsim.getNetsimNetwork());
270:         if(invalid!=null){step.rejected++;evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,candidate,position,invalid);return;}
271:         var oldEstimate=router.evaluate(old.subList(index,old.size()),now,person,vehicle,enteredAt);
272:         var candidateEstimate=router.evaluate(suffix,now,person,vehicle,enteredAt);
273:         if (!shouldInstall(enabled,oldEstimate.cost(),candidateEstimate.cost())) {
274:             step.rejected++; evidence(now,"zona1RerouteRejected",agent,index,old,candidate,position,
275:                 "no_expected_improvement",oldEstimate,candidateEstimate,enteredAt); return;
276:         }
277:         if (!candidate.equals(old)) {
278:             var replacement=route.clone();
279:             replacement.setLinkIds(candidate.get(0),candidate.subList(1,Math.max(1,candidate.size()-1)),candidate.get(candidate.size()-1));
280:             replacement.setDistance(RouteUtils.calcDistance(replacement,1.,1.,scenario.getNetwork()));
281:             replacement.setTravelTimeUndefined();
282:             leg.setRoute(replacement);
283:             // EditRoutes.replanCurrentLeg already resets caches. We replace its splice,
284:             // so refresh once after our own validated installation.
285:             WithinDayAgentUtils.resetCaches(agent);
286:             int after=WithinDayAgentUtils.getCurrentRouteLinkIdIndex(agent);
287:             var driver=(MobsimDriverAgent)agent;
288:             boolean nextValid=index==candidate.size()-1 ? driver.isWantingToArriveOnCurrentLink() :
289:                 Objects.equals(candidate.get(index+1),driver.chooseNextLinkId());
290:             if (after!=index || !nextValid) {
291:                 leg.setRoute(route); WithinDayAgentUtils.resetCaches(agent);
292:                 fatal(now,agent,index,old,position,"post_install_index_or_next_link_mismatch candidate="+candidate);
293:             }
294:             step.installed++;
295:         }
296:         evidence(now,"zona1WithinDayReroute",agent,index,old,candidate,position,
297:             "validated_improvement",oldEstimate,candidateEstimate,enteredAt);
298:     }
299:     @Override public void notifyMobsimBeforeSimStep(MobsimBeforeSimStepEvent event) {
300:         double now=event.getSimulationTime(); if (now<next) return; next=now+60;
301:         var step=new Step(); long wall=System.nanoTime(); var bean=ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean();
302:         long cpu=bean.isCurrentThreadCpuTimeSupported()?bean.getCurrentThreadCpuTime():-1;
303:         try {
304:             if (!enabled) return;
305:             Set<Id<Link>> severe=new HashSet<>();
306:             for (Link link:scenario.getNetwork().getLinks().values()) {
307:                 double nominal=Math.max(1,link.getLength()/link.getFreespeed());
308:                 double estimate=link.getLength()/Math.max(.1,link.getFreespeed(now));
309:                 double observed=observedLinkSeconds(link.getId(),now);
310:                 if (!Double.isNaN(observed)) estimate=Math.max(estimate,observed);
311:                 times.put(link.getId(),estimate);
312:                 if (needsReroute(enabled,nominal,estimate,link.getCapacity(),link.getCapacity(now))) severe.add(link.getId());
313:             }
314:             turnTimes.clear();
315:             turnObservations.forEach((turn,observation)->{
316:                 if (fresh(observation,now)) {
317:                     Link from=scenario.getNetwork().getLinks().get(turn.from());
318:                     double currentFreeflow=from.getLength()/Math.max(.1,from.getFreespeed(now));
319:                     turnTimes.put(turn,Math.max(currentFreeflow,observation.duration()));
320:                 }
321:             });
322:             if (severe.isEmpty()) return;
323:             var candidates=new ArrayList<MobsimAgent>();
324:             for (MobsimAgent agent:qsim.getAgents().values()) {
325:                 if (SimZ1Freight.applies(scenario.getPopulation().getPersons().get(agent.getId()))) continue;
326:                 if (agent instanceof org.matsim.core.mobsim.qsim.pt.TransitDriverAgent ||
327:                     !selected.contains(agent.getId()) || !(agent instanceof MobsimDriverAgent) ||
328:                     agent.getState()!=MobsimAgent.State.LEG || !"car".equals(agent.getMode()) ||
329:                     now-last.getOrDefault(agent.getId(),Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)<300) continue;
330:                 if (isRegisteredTransitVehicle(((MobsimDriverAgent)agent).getPlannedVehicleId())) continue;
331:                 var leg=WithinDayAgentUtils.getModifiableCurrentLeg(agent);
332:                 if (leg==null || !(leg.getRoute() instanceof NetworkRoute route)) continue;
333:                 var full=SimZ1RouteSafety.full(route); int index=WithinDayAgentUtils.getCurrentRouteLinkIdIndex(agent);
334:                 String invalid=safety.validateReplacement(full,full,index,agent.getCurrentLinkId(),route.getEndLinkId(),null);
335:                 if (invalid!=null) fatal(now,agent,index,full,null,invalid);
336:                 if (index==full.size()-1) continue; // occurrence/index, not currentLinkId==endLinkId
337:                 // Preserve the existing downstream trigger: rerouting cannot undo the current link already occupied.
338:                 if (full.subList(index+1,full.size()).stream().anyMatch(severe::contains)) candidates.add(agent);
339:             }
340:             candidates.sort(Comparator.comparing(a->a.getId().toString())); step.candidates=candidates.size();
341:             // Deterministic cyclic priority avoids starving lexicographically later IDs.
342:             int first=0; while(first<candidates.size() && candidates.get(first).getId().toString().compareTo(cursor)<=0) first++;
343:             int attempts=Math.min(budget,candidates.size()); step.deferred=candidates.size()-attempts;
344:             for (int i=0;i<attempts;i++) {
345:                 MobsimAgent agent=candidates.get((first+i)%candidates.size()); cursor=agent.getId().toString();
346:                 attempt(agent,now,step);
347:             }
348:         } finally {
349:             long elapsedCpu=cpu<0?-1:bean.getCurrentThreadCpuTime()-cpu;
350:             emit(now,"zona1RerouteStep",Map.of("candidates",""+step.candidates,"calculations",""+step.calculations,
351:                 "installed",""+step.installed,"rejected",""+step.rejected,"deferred",""+step.deferred,
352:                 "budget",""+budget,"cpuNanos",""+elapsedCpu,"wallNanos",""+(System.nanoTime()-wall),"enabled",""+enabled));
353:         }
354:     }

5: /** Typed config module so MATSim can materialize it in the controller injector. */
6: public final class Zona1RoutingConfigGroup extends ReflectiveConfigGroup {
7:     private String enabled = "true";

10:     private String routingPolicy = DrivingProfiles.FASTEST_TIME;
11:     @StringGetter("routingPolicy") public String getRoutingPolicy() { return routingPolicy; }
12:     @StringSetter("routingPolicy") public void setRoutingPolicy(String value) {
13:         routingPolicy = DrivingProfiles.validatePolicy(value);
14:     }
15:     @StringGetter("maxReroutesPerStep") public int getMaxReroutesPerStep() { return maxReroutesPerStep; }
16:     @StringSetter("maxReroutesPerStep") public void setMaxReroutesPerStep(int value) {
17:         if (value < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxReroutesPerStep must be positive");
18:         maxReroutesPerStep = value;
19:     }

266:         if (actualLane != null && index+1 < candidate.size() && !laneAllows(actualCurrent, actualLane, candidate.get(index+1)))

188:         public void observeHeads(QNetwork network,double now) {
189:             boolean newStep=step!=now;
190:             if(newStep){step=now;crossed.clear();reservation=null;}
191:             for(var link:node.getInLinks().values()) if(roadLink(link))
192:                 for(var lane:network.getNetsimLinks().get(link.getId()).getOfferingQLanes())
193:                     if(!lane.isNotOfferingVehicle()) head(link,lane,lane.getFirstVehicle(),now);
194:             if(newStep && settings.getMaxYieldSeconds()>0) {
195:                 // Select before any crossing this step. Reservation only lasts this
196:                 // node step and never overrides red, forbidden turns or storage.
197:                 // Stable ordering makes equal-age choices independent of hash maps.
198:                 for(var link:node.getInLinks().values().stream().filter(l->roadLink(l)&&street(l))
199:                         .sorted(Comparator.comparing(l->l.getId().toString())).toList())

205:                         if(reservation==null || stop.ready<reservation.ready)

44:     private static double cross(double[] a,double[] b,double[] c){return (b[0]-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])-(b[1]-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0]);}
45:     private static boolean disjointChords(Node n,Movement a,Movement b) {
46:         double[][] p={point(n,n.getInLinks().get(a.from).getFromNode()),point(n,n.getOutLinks().get(a.to).getToNode()),
47:                       point(n,n.getInLinks().get(b.from).getFromNode()),point(n,n.getOutLinks().get(b.to).getToNode())};
48:         for(int i=0;i<4;i++) for(int j=0;j<i;j++) if(Math.hypot(p[i][0]-p[j][0],p[i][1]-p[j][1])<1e-6) return false;
49:         double c1=cross(p[0],p[1],p[2]),c2=cross(p[0],p[1],p[3]),c3=cross(p[2],p[3],p[0]),c4=cross(p[2],p[3],p[1]);
50:         if(Math.min(Math.min(Math.abs(c1),Math.abs(c2)),Math.min(Math.abs(c3),Math.abs(c4)))<1e-6) return false;
51:         return c1*c2>0 || c3*c4>0;
52:     }
53:     private static boolean oppositeThrough(Node n,Movement a,Movement b) {
54:         var ai=n.getInLinks().get(a.from); var ao=n.getOutLinks().get(a.to);
55:         var bi=n.getInLinks().get(b.from); var bo=n.getOutLinks().get(b.to);
56:         // Exact reciprocal topology establishes two existing opposite directions;
57:         // no direction of circulation is invented from an axis or road name.
58:         if(ai.getFromNode()!=bo.getToNode()||bi.getFromNode()!=ao.getToNode()) return false;
59:         var x=point(n,ai.getFromNode()); var y=point(n,bi.getFromNode());
60:         return x[0]*y[0]+x[1]*y[1] < -Math.cos(Math.toRadians(15));
61:     }
62:     public String evidence(Movement a,Movement b) {
63:         if(a.from.equals(b.from)) return "same_approach_native_queue";
64:         if(a.to.equals(b.to)) return "shared_exit_merge";
65:         if(disjoint.contains(Set.of(a,b))) return "verified_node_table";
66:         if(geometric) {
67:             try {
68:                 if(oppositeThrough(node,a,b)) return "reciprocal_opposite_through";
69:                 if(disjointChords(node,a,b)) return "separated_geometric_chords";
70:             } catch(IllegalArgumentException | NullPointerException ignored) {
71:                 // Missing/degenerate geometry cannot prove a safe non-conflict.
72:             }
73:         }
74:         return "conflicting_or_ambiguous";
75:     }
76:     public boolean conflicts(Movement a,Movement b) {
77:         // Same approach is served serially by QSim queues and their flow limits.
78:         return Set.of("shared_exit_merge","conflicting_or_ambiguous").contains(evidence(a,b));
79:     }
80: }

374: 	private void updateSlowFlowAccumulation(){
375: 		double remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep = subtractConsumptionOfVehiclesThatAreAlreadyInTheBuffer();
376: 		
377: 		if (this.thisTimeStepGreen
378: 				&& this.flowcap_accumulate.getValue() < remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep){
379: 			double newFlowCap = Math.min(flowcap_accumulate.getValue() + flowCapacityPerTimeStep,
380: 					remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep);
381: 			flowcap_accumulate.setValue(newFlowCap);
382: 		}
383: 	}
384: 
385: 	private double subtractConsumptionOfVehiclesThatAreAlreadyInTheBuffer() {
386: 		// A SimZ1 original queue multiplexes independently reserved lanes. A
387: 		// retained grant in another slot must not permanently freeze the native
388: 		// travelling head before originalSlotHeads() can even observe it. Keep
389: 		// the accumulated debt and its ordinary rate/ceiling: this changes only
390: 		// the ceiling imposed by old, blocked buffer entries, never grants flow.
391: 		if (independentOriginalHeadMayAccumulate()) return flowCapacityPerTimeStep;
392: 		double remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep = flowCapacityPerTimeStep;
393: 		for (Pair<QVehicle,Double> vehEfficiencyPair : buffer) {
394: 			// Subtract size of vehicles that are already in the buffer (from previous time steps)
395: 			remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep -= vehEfficiencyPair.getValue();
396: 		}
397: 		return remainingFlowCapThisTimeStep;
398: 	}
399: 
400:     private boolean independentOriginalHeadMayAccumulate() {
401:         if(effectiveNumberOfLanesUsedInQsim<2||!(vehQueue instanceof FIFOVehicleQ)
402:                 ||context.qsimConfig.getTrafficDynamics()!=QSimConfigGroup.TrafficDynamics.queue
403:                 ||!id.toString().equals(qLink.getId()+".original")||buffer.isEmpty())return false;
404:         var ledger=occupancy();var head=vehQueue.peek();double now=context.getSimTimer().getTimeOfDay();
405:         if(ledger==null||head==null||head.getEarliestLinkExitTime()>now
406:                 ||lastBufferEntry==null||lastBufferEntry.getValue()>=now)return false;
407:         int slot=ledger.originalSlot(head,qLink.getId(),id.toString());if(slot<0)return false;
408:         for(var entry:buffer) {
409:             int bufferedSlot=ledger.originalSlot(entry.getKey(),qLink.getId(),id.toString());
410:             // Unresolved bodies and a predecessor in the same lane remain
411:             // barriers. In particular, no connector passage is bypassed.
412:             if(bufferedSlot<0||bufferedSlot==slot)return false;
413:         }
414:         return true;
415:     }

280:     def validate_observed_route(self, ident, path, *, complete=False):
281:         row = self.records[ident]
282:         if not path or path[0] != row['origin_link'] or any(k not in self.allowed(row) for k in path):
283:             raise ValueError('Private observed route escaped its selected gateways/interior')
284:         self.model.validate_route(path)
285:         if row['origin_gateway']:
286:             chain = self.model.entry_gateways[row['origin_gateway']]['link_ids']
287:             n = min(len(path), len(chain))
288:             if path[:n] != chain[:n]:
289:                 raise ValueError('Private route skipped part of its verified entry chain')
290:         if row['destination_gateway']:
291:             chain = self.model.exit_gateways[row['destination_gateway']]['link_ids']
292:             # Until entering the crossing, a reroute may revisit the interior
293:             # observation. Once crossing, its entire suffix is compulsory.
294:             cut = row['exit_crossing_link']
295:             if cut in path:
296:                 start = path.index(cut)-chain.index(cut)
297:                 tail = path[start:] if start >= 0 else []
298:                 if start < 0 or tail != chain[:len(tail)]:
299:                     raise ValueError('Private route skipped part of its verified exit chain')
300:         crossings = [k for k in path if self.model.classification[k] in ('entry_crossing','exit_crossing')]
301:         expected = [k for k in (row['entry_crossing_link'], row['exit_crossing_link']) if k]
302:         if crossings != expected[:len(crossings)] or len(crossings) > len(expected):
303:             raise ValueError('Private route used an undeclared/repeated perimeter crossing')
304:         if complete and (path[-1] != row['destination_link'] or crossings != expected or
305:                 not set(path) & set(self.model.internal_links)):
306:             raise ValueError('Private trip did not complete its directed interior/gateway route')

232: def watch(run, interval):
233:     """Tail ONE explicit run. Does not write files or start native processes."""
234:     run = Path(run).resolve()
235:     reader = None
236:     observation = None
237:     cargo = None
238:     try:
239:         while True:
240:             path = run/'run-manifest.json'
241:             if not path.exists():
242:                 print(json.dumps(dict(status='waiting_for_manifest',run=str(run))), flush=True)
243:                 time.sleep(interval); continue
244:             manifest = load_manifest(run)
245:             if (manifest.get('spatial_demand') or {}).get('mode') != VARIANT:
246:                 raise ValueError('El manifiesto no corresponde a balanced-gateway-v1')
247:             events = run/'output/ITERS/it.0/0.events.xml.gz'
248:             if observation is None and events.is_file():
249:                 observation, freight_contract = context(run,manifest)
250:                 from simz1_freight import FreightAudit
251:                 cargo = FreightAudit(freight_contract)
252:                 reader = GrowingEvents(events)
253:             if reader is not None:
254:                 for event in reader.poll():
255:                     observation.consume(event)
256:                     cargo.consume(ET.Element('event',event))
257:             value = dict(status=manifest['status'], phase=manifest.get('phase'), run_id=manifest['run_id'],
258:                 evidence='LIVE_PROVISIONAL_NOT_VALIDATION', first_causal_error=manifest.get('first_causal_error'),
259:                 error=manifest.get('error'), events=str(events),
260:                 observed=observation.view() if observation else None,
261:                 freight_observed=(dict(completed=len(cargo.finished), restricted_window_vehicles=len(cargo.violations),
262:                     native_active=len(cargo.traffic),waiting_to_incorporate=len(set(cargo.active)-cargo.seen)) if cargo else None),
263:                 compressed_bytes_consumed=reader.stream.tell() if reader else 0,
264:                 compressed_bytes_available=events.stat().st_size if events.is_file() else 0)
265:             print(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
266:             if manifest['status'] in ('completed','failed','interrupted'):
267:                 if reader is None or reader.stream.tell() >= events.stat().st_size:
268:                     return
269:             time.sleep(interval)
270:     finally:
